description: This file contains regex patterns and utility functions for identifying and processing mentions in text, such as file paths, URLs, and specific keywords like 'problems', 'git-changes', and 'terminal'. It also includes functions for formatting git commit suggestions and unescaping paths with escaped spaces.

methods.name: formatGitSuggestion
methods.description: Formats a commit object into a GitMentionSuggestion with label, description, and icon.

methods.name: unescapeSpaces
methods.description: Replaces escaped spaces in a path string with actual spaces.
